dateAssessment: The working calendar uses YAML’s year 1749 and the spoken August 7 morning anchor (t01, u0200–u0203). All played activity fits August 7: the party reaches Three Wells about 11:30, Delwath rests and scries around midday, messages occupy the afternoon, and the party settles for the night. YAML assessment: matched, zero date boundaries. The remembered 2 a.m. conversation is prior-session context; forecasts, the joking sunset during Kenzo’s oath and the proposed raids establish no additional elapsed play. The ten-minute scry includes t07’s two-to-three-minute advance; count that interval once. Closing sleep has begun, with no completed long rest or waking. Dinner and the contiguous night conversation are shown as an inferred dusk watch; an exact bedtime is not established.

watches.summary: August 7 morning explicitly anchors the resumed hillock interrogation.
Two-hour flight ends about 11:30; interrogation, one-hour short rest and ten-minute scry follow around midday.
A good part of the afternoon passes sending messages and organizing troop movements.
Dinner is followed by night-camp conversation; the party then drifts off, with the overnight rest incomplete.
